subject: science
concept: Understanding basic causes of major weather events (storms) and how scientists track them
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Space Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Weather and Climate) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student examines simplified weather-map data showing conditions that lead to a storm forming
exercise.pictorial: Student matches weather map symbols to their meaning
exercise.abstract: Student explains at a basic level what conditions can lead to a described weather event

misconception_flags: believes severe weather forms with no identifiable causes or patterns

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
